note: Rivals (rules v2). Enemies are made by wounds (origins, called scars). Political rivals are made by ambition (types). Both are data so new kinds can be added. All invention.

origins.name: Exiled
origins.effect: Acts only from outside the walls. Recruits other exiles at +1.

origins.name: Bereaved
origins.effect: Can't be bribed. +1 on every roll against you.

origins.name: Humiliated
origins.madeBy: You refused, stripped or shamed them in public.
origins.effect: Plants rumors at +1. Their grudge can't be cleared by a bribe.

origins.name: Survivor
origins.madeBy: They survived a failed plot against you.
origins.effect: +1 to any plot strike they lead.

ranks.title: Schemer
ranks.effect: Recruits twice a season. Adds +1 to plot strength.

ranks.title: Faction leader
ranks.effect: Can lead a plot without a faction behind it. Adds +2.

ranks.title: Nemesis
ranks.effect: Gains the agenda Your fall, shown in full. Adds +3. Only one at a time.

politicalTypes.name: Climber
politicalTypes.leansOn: Lend, petitions for offices, marriage into your family

politicalTypes.name: Heir
politicalTypes.leansOn: Winning commands and the guard's favour, waiting for you to stumble

politicalTypes.name: Champion
politicalTypes.leansOn: Building a following, winning votes, speaking for the people

politicalRanks.title: Power behind the throne
politicalRanks.effect: Holds 2 or more offices, or leverage over you.

politicalRanks.title: Pretender
politicalRanks.effect: Gains the agenda Take his place, shown in full.
